reasoning: In .github/dependabot.yml, github-actions bumps carry the prefix 'ci(deps) [skip release]'. Dependabot puts the prefix in both the PR title and the commit message, so the marker survives a squash merge (subject) and a merge commit (body). auto-tag reads it anywhere in the head message, as CLAUDE.md requires for non-code pushes. The swift ecosystem uses the 'deps' prefix, which gives a patch release, correct because the shipped code changes.
